base_url.correction: No universal base URL. Use the cluster-specific REST API base URL shown under API Access, following https://{regional-api-host}/api/v2/orgs/{orgId}/clusters/{clusterId}.

auth_type.correction: bearerToken (JWT supplied through the Authorization: Bearer header)

free_tier.correction: false for REST API access. The permanently free Serverless plan excludes the REST API; REST API access requires Starter, which offers only a 15-day trial.

free_tier_limits.correction: No ongoing free REST API tier. Starter has a 15-day trial without a credit card; the free Serverless broker allows 100 connections and 10 GB monthly traffic but does not include REST API access.

example.correction: A documented listing request is: curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT_TOKEN" "https://{regional-api-host}/api/v2/orgs/{orgId}/clusters/{clusterId}/mqtt/credentials". The documented API has no GET /v1/clusters endpoint.

description.correction: HiveMQ Cloud is a managed MQTT platform whose REST API manages cluster-scoped MQTT credentials, permissions, roles, clients, and metrics. Current documentation does not support claims that this API provisions MQTT environments or lists and manages account clusters.

notes: The submitted entry appears to combine an invented global management API with HiveMQ's real cluster-scoped REST API. Current endpoints use /api/v2/orgs/{orgId}/clusters/{clusterId}, require a JWT bearer token, and are available on Starter rather than the permanently free Serverless plan.
